info.description: Shared Platform API for the web dashboards, mobile app, and Android player.

post.description: Creates the asset and a presigned PUT URL. The lifetime grows with the file size (15 minutes to 6 hours).
A fresh presigned PUT URL for an asset that is still UPLOADING or FAILED. Uploads left UPLOADING for 24 hours are deleted.

202.description: View recorded (one per user per 30 minutes)

get.description: Sent notifications addressed to the caller (everyone, their company, or them), newest first.
One notification, if the caller is in its audience (any, for the Super Admin).
